rules.statement: Preserve presented relationships programmatically, and make headings and labels describe their purpose.
rules.limitations: Visual hierarchy alone does not satisfy semantic structure; headings are not universally required.

rules.statement: Meet criterion-specific contrast thresholds and never use color as the only information cue.
rules.limitations: Thresholds and exceptions differ for text, controls, states, and inactive elements.

rules.statement: Support reflow at 320 CSS pixels except where two-dimensional presentation is essential.
rules.limitations: Tables, maps, video, and diagrams require scoped exception analysis, not blanket exemption.

rules.statement: Keep functionality keyboard operable and keyboard focus visibly indicated.
rules.limitations: Path-dependent functions have a narrow keyboard exception; focus appearance is separately governed.

rules.statement: Provide 24-by-24 CSS pixel pointer targets or qualifying spacing at WCAG AA.
rules.limitations: Preserve inline, equivalent, user-agent, and essential exceptions; 44-by-44 is not the AA threshold.

rules.statement: Identify erroneous items and describe each error in text without relying on color alone.
rules.limitations: This rule does not prescribe a specific summary layout or validation timing.

rules.statement: Expose applicable status updates programmatically without moving focus.
rules.limitations: Not every dynamic content change qualifies as a status message.

rules.statement: Preserve content and functionality at 200 percent text resize and under specified spacing overrides.
rules.limitations: Test override values are not default typography prescriptions, and WCAG sets no default font size.

rules.statement: Allow users to disable nonessential motion triggered by interaction.
rules.limitations: Animation from interactions is WCAG Level AAA, not an AA conformance requirement.

rules.statement: Use a named, configurable spacing scale rather than assuming a universal pixel grid.
rules.limitations: The sampled systems differ in exact values; the sample is not universal or statistically representative.

rules.statement: Use role-based layout and typography tokens to communicate hierarchy while keeping values system-specific.
rules.limitations: Fonts, tonal algorithms, breakpoints, radii, and token names remain product-specific conventions.

rules.statement: Start narrow layouts with one column and bound prose measure for readability.
rules.limitations: The two systems recommend different measures; neither value is a WCAG requirement.

rules.statement: Default to submit-first validation, preserve entered values, and link summaries to inline errors.
rules.limitations: Use live validation only for bounded, evidence-backed cases; other systems permit it more broadly.

rules.statement: Distinguish focus, hover, active, selected, disabled, error, and loading states with semantic cues.
rules.limitations: Atlassian deep-link availability reduced source precision; native disabled behavior remains preferable.

rules.statement: Model loading, partial or ready, success, empty, error, cancelled, retrying, and stale states explicitly.
rules.limitations: The taxonomy is synthesized; no universal spinner or skeleton timing threshold survived review.
